sql: SELECT 'g1' g, main_cat, COUNT(*) c FROM items_g1 GROUP BY main_cat UNION ALL SELECT 'g2', main_cat, COUNT(*) FROM items_g2 GROUP BY main_cat UNION ALL SELECT 'g3', main_cat, COUNT(*) FROM items_g3 GROUP BY main_cat;
SELECT COUNT(*) n, MIN(ts) mn, MAX(ts) mx, typeof(MIN(ts)) t FROM fdbk_g2;
SELECT ts, datetime(ts,'unixepoch') d FROM fdbk_g2 ORDER BY ts LIMIT 5;
SELECT LENGTH(CAST(ts AS TEXT)) len, COUNT(*) c, MIN(ts) mn, MAX(ts) mx FROM fdbk_g2 GROUP BY len ORDER BY len;

SELECT
  strftime('%Y', ts,'unixepoch') yr,
  COUNT(*) c
FROM fdbk_g2
WHERE ts BETWEEN 1633046400 AND 1640995199
GROUP BY yr;

-- show monthly buckets around Q4 2021 for context
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', ts,'unixepoch') ym, COUNT(*) c
FROM fdbk_g2
WHERE ts >= 1630454400 AND ts < 1643673600
GROUP BY ym ORDER BY ym;
SELECT main_cat, COUNT(*) c FROM items_g3 GROUP BY main_cat ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS q4_2021_electronics_reviews
FROM fdbk_g2
WHERE ts >= strftime('%s','2021-10-01 00:00:00')
  AND ts <= strftime('%s','2021-12-31 23:59:59');
